title: Implement structured tracing with tokio-tracing across both binaries
description:
Add tokio-tracing to both transit and reader. Default format: JSON to stdout. Configure log level via RUST_LOG env var and via config file [log] section. Key spans to instrument: NNTP session lifecycle, article ingestion pipeline, IPFS write, group log append, gossipsub publish. Artifact: shared tracing setup in core/src/tracing.rs, called from both binary main.rs files.

Acceptance:
- JSON log output includes: timestamp, level, target, span name, message
- RUST_LOG=debug produces debug-level output; RUST_LOG=info suppresses debug
- Per-session span includes peer IP address (for reader) or remote peer ID (for transit)
- No sensitive data (keys, passwords) appears in any log output
- cargo test does not emit tracing output unless RUST_LOG set
